column1: # Run-on speech development set: several thoughts in one breath, no marker.
# Written for the largest remaining framing family. The everyday table reports
# `run-on` at 0/8 on routing and `multi-thought` at 19/40; the sentences behind
# those rates were not read to write this file, and nothing here was copied
# from a held-out set. It is the same provenance as `framing.tsv`.
# NOT held out: these are for iteration. Read the failures, fix the layer, run
# What this set asserts, so that it can be argued with
# A recording carrying two thoughts about DIFFERENT things is two rows, even
# when nothing separates them but a breath. Two statements about the SAME
# thing are one note — "the dentist is on Pine Street the parking is round the
# back" is one thing a person will want to find later, and splitting it makes
# them find half. That line is a product decision, not a measurement, and the
# guards below are where it is drawn.
# On the destination column: the scorer asks whether the wanted destination is
# among the routes produced, so a capture holding a fact and an errand is
# marked `Today`. A missed errand is the visible harm; the count column is what
# Columns: id, utterance, family, expected_destination, expected_thoughts

column2: utterance

column1: # --- Errands run together, nothing between them -----------------------------

column2: pick up the dry cleaning call the bank about the overdraft
water the plants take the recycling out
book the car in for Thursday renew my passport
email Priya the invoice order more printer paper
pay the hydro bill cancel the gym membership

column1: # --- A statement and an errand, in one breath -------------------------------

column2: the boiler is making that noise again book the plumber
the conference moved to Halifax I need to rebook the flights
Priya starts on the 14th order her a laptop
the warranty ran out in June call the shop about a repair quote
our wifi drops every evening replace the router

the chili needs two cans of tomatoes add them to the shopping list
the rent goes up sixty dollars in April my lease renews in March
Maya's new number ends in 4417 the office moved to the third floor
the flight lands at 6:40 Ines is bringing the projector
Dad's blood type is O negative the spare key is under the planter
the conference is in Halifax this year Okonkwo is chairing the panel

column1: # --- Guards: two statements about ONE thing stay one note -------------------

column2: the dentist is on Pine Street the parking is round the back
the boiler pressure sits at one bar the manual says one and a half
the recipe takes an hour it serves six
Priya moved to the Toronto office she starts on the 14th

column1: # --- Guards: a fronted adjunct is not a second thought ----------------------
